ledger_definition: Iterate selected original tensor indices ascending, then sorted local slots; append dict(index,name,slot,bytes,sha256) from actual read bytes; SHA256 of json.dumps(ledger,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode().
reproduction: Read the geometry from configs/glm-5.2-fp8-config.json and inspect_source_inventory at the named path. Call read_ws32_layer_subset_metadata with recorded pins, layers, local slots and byte budget; iterate iter_ws32_layer_subset_host_tensors, summing host.nbytes and computing the ledger digest as defined. JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu. Do not initialize JAX or load onto TPU for this host-only check.
limitations: Only the controller's four retained owner files were checked, not the other seven hosts.
Only selected layer payloads were hashed and checked finite; whole-file hashes and unselected payloads were not verified.
Pinned topology metadata was authenticated; no fresh live physical topology or accelerator census was performed by this check.
This is host-byte admission, not full-layer TPU arithmetic, measured HBM, protected performance or full-decoder admission.
